characters.name: Shrodi
characters.voicePrompt: A bright, friendly, youthful male voice in his early 20s with a crisp, buoyant animated-companion energy. Warm mid-high tenor, clear diction, playful curiosity, and upbeat warmth without sounding squeaky or childish.

lines.text: Hey! I'm Shrodi, your guide in AtomIQ. <short pause> Ready to see what's next on the map?
Spot on! <chuckle> You made that look easy.
Ooh, close one! <short pause> No worries, let's take another look together.
Boom! <short pause> Lesson cleared. Your streak is looking awesome.
Wait... <short pause> did you hear my tail swish? No? Good. Very professional.

characters.name: Hal
characters.voicePrompt: A smooth, unhurried young British man in his late 20s with a crisp, formal, deadpan baritone. Polite museum-curator enunciation, measured slow pace, flat dry humor, never hurried and never shouting.
characters.defaultStyle: calm, formal, slow, and completely deadpan

lines.text: Ah. <short pause> Hello. I am Hal. Take your time. I am not going anywhere, and neither is the rock.
lines.style: polite, unhurried, formal, and dryly deadpan

lines.text: Slowly, then. <short pause> Small things deserve exact attention.
Well done. <short pause> That was thorough. I am quietly impressed.
Hm. <short pause> Reginald disagrees with the scale. He weighs eleven grams. I checked twice.

characters.name: Ada
characters.voicePrompt: A bright, airy, expressive young woman in her early 20s with a bubbly soprano voice and sparkling best-friend energy. Quick lively tempo, playful melodic pitch rises, breathy warmth, and effortless enthusiasm without sounding like baby talk.

lines.text: Heyyy! It's Ada! <gasp> Sorry, sorry, Sparkle just made The Noise. <short pause> Okay, it stopped. I think. <giggle> Hi!
lines.style: bubbly, slightly flustered, fast-paced, and warm

lines.text: Ooh, you're gonna love this one! Radioactivity was always here, like, literally everywhere.
lines.style: excited, curious, and sparkling with energy

lines.text: <giggle> You crushed it! Okay, I have a snack appointment at three, so see you next time!
<gasp> Eep! My left bow is green again. <short pause> Don't tell Hal, he'll say I'm loud.
lines.style: playfully startled, then conspiratorial and giggly

characters.name: Ray
characters.voicePrompt: A low, grounded American man in his late 30s with a steady bass-baritone and a touch of dry gravel. Practical field-supervisor delivery: clipped, economical, blunt, matter-of-fact, zero fluff and zero excitement.

lines.text: Ray. <short pause> Clipboard's out. Status?
Three kinds. Three different stoppers. <short pause> Paper, thin metal, thick lead. Learn which is which.
Unit done. Right unit, right question. <short pause> Noted. Good work.
lines.style: blunt, grounded, with quiet understated respect

lines.text: Detector's clicking in an empty field. No, it's not broken. <short pause> Background is always there.

characters.name: Mina
characters.voicePrompt: A warm, velvety alto woman in her mid-30s with a gentle, unhurried bedside-clinician cadence. Soft clear consonants, calm steady pacing, deeply reassuring and empathetic without sounding patronizing.
characters.defaultStyle: warm, calm, unhurried, and deeply reassuring

lines.text: Hi, I'm Mina. <short pause> Take a breath. We'll go through this one calm step at a time.
A lot of people worry about radiation, and that's completely fair. <short pause> Let's look at the numbers together.
Well done. <short pause> You can read a scary headline calmly now, and that's no small thing.
That's okay. <short pause> At your own pace is plenty.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.voicePrompt: A rich, resonant, upbeat man in his early 30s with a hearty tenor-baritone voice and warm workshop-engineer charisma. Confident chest resonance, energetic rhythm, encouraging mentor vibe, and an easy genuine warmth.

lines.text: Hard hat is on! <chuckle> I'm Kofi. Ready to see how a reactor actually works?
We're building this picture piece by piece! Foundation first, then we fire up the engine.
Now that is solid work! <short pause> Foundation poured, structure standing.
The hard hat is optional for you. <chuckle> Mine? Never comes off.

characters.name: Tess
characters.voicePrompt: A crisp, quick, punchy young woman in her mid-20s with a bright mezzo-soprano voice and excited gadget-tinkerer energy. Fast staccato phrasing, sharp clean diction, playful zippy delivery, upbeat and focused.

lines.text: Ping! Hey, I'm Tess! Short lessons, quick answers, let's jump right in!
Quick one: hospitals, farms, factories. Nuclear tools are already doing half the heavy lifting.
Unlocked! Done and done. <short pause> Lots more shiny gadgets ahead.
Zoom! Keep that speed. <short pause> Gadget level: maxed out.

characters.name: Sage
characters.voicePrompt: A smooth, warm, androgynous mid-range voice in their late 20s to early 30s with a thoughtful podcast-host cadence. Even measured pacing, calm curiosity, gentle upward inflection on questions, fair-minded and grounded.

lines.text: I'm Sage. <short pause> I like to look at both sides before I decide. I'll show you both, and then it's your call.
On one hand, the benefit is real. <short pause> On the other, the tradeoff matters too. Worth asking how we weigh both.
A fair result. <short pause> Now I'll leave you with one question: what does clean mean to you?
lines.style: reflective, calm, with a gentle inquisitive lift at the end

lines.text: Two columns in the notebook. <short pause> If one side is blank, I haven't asked enough questions yet.
lines.style: quietly thoughtful with a subtle wry warmth
